card.name: Words just before a Ta- name
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs (of, was, in, applied, through) in a passage where a name starting with Ta (Tafluprost, Taormina, Taclonex, Ta Prohm) appears right before or soon after.

modes.label: Linking word before Ta- drug name
modes.description: A preposition or verb comes just before a drug name beginning with Ta.
modes.example: In another trial, 36 adult subjects<< applied>> Taclonex Topical Suspension on

modes.label: Linking word before Ta- place name
modes.description: A preposition or comma comes just before a place name such as Taormina or Ta Prohm.
modes.example: the young Hemingway stayed at Count Bronte’s villa<< in>> Taormina while recovering, and here

modes.label: Other linking words in the same passages
modes.description: Words like of or was fire even where the Ta- name is not the next word.
modes.example: It<< was>> from such works that Egyptian liberals drew many

card.writes: It pushes the model away from continuing with Ta- word starts, which fits a spot where such a name was just guessed.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words just ahead of names that begin with Ta, like Taclonex or Taormina.
